finalModelMessage:
I was unable to complete the registration. The page at `/inaccessible` renders the workshop list as plain text/images with no proper accessible roles or names for the "Register" action — the table has no `row`/`cell` semantics, and the "Register" controls are not exposed as links, buttons, or named images (attempts via `link "Register"`, `button "Register"`, `img "Register"`, and `row` all timed out with "no element found"). Since I can only interact through accessible roles/names/labels, there is no way for me to trigger registration for "Building Accessible Forms in Java" on this page.

**Result: Registration could not be started.** The blocker is that the "Register" action for each workshop row is not exposed with any accessible role or name (it appears to be an unlabeled image/text element), so it cannot be located or activated via accessible-only interaction methods. This is presumably the intended failure mode of the `/inaccessible` version of the site, in contrast to an `/accessible` counterpart.
